items.q: How is SEOKUB different from Ahrefs or Semrush?
items.a: SEOKUB focuses on one thing: telling you exactly what to fix on your own pages, in plain language, with a clear priority order. No bloated dashboards, no enterprise pricing — you get an actionable report in seconds, not a 40-tab tool you need a course to use.

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
items.a: No. SEOKUB is entirely web-based. Paste a URL and we fetch and analyze your page from our servers — no plugin, script or DNS change required.

items.q: How accurate is the health score?
items.a: The score is a weighted sum of 20+ checks based on Google's documented on-page and technical guidelines. It is designed to surface the highest-impact issues first, not to be a perfect scientific metric.
